_comment: The tools a HOSTED key (the public /mcp door) may use, by exact name. allow is the work surface. gate is the exact outward setup tools a hosted key may propose; each one is held for the person's tap. Both lists are the only declaration. Read by core/modules/agent-reach.js hostedKeyMay. test/hosted-keys.test.js holds the set over the registry equal to this file, so a new, renamed or removed tool fails CI until someone places it here or in test/hosted-refused.json.
